not_lending: “{name}” doesn't lend its models for conversations (“Lend my models” setting on that machine).
phone_for_friends: “{name}” is a phone: it only lends to its friends while charging and on Wi-Fi.
model_gone: The model “{model}” is no longer installed on “{name}”.
busy: “{name}” has been answering other conversations for a long time: try again in a moment.
unpaired: This machine is no longer paired: choose another model.
unreachable: “{name}” is unreachable for now (no address on the local network, no Internet key).
read_mine_only: Only my machines can ask this machine for a reading.
read_unavailable: “{name}” can't read a text under a model (it needs the built-in engine).
read_invalid: Texts to read are invalid or too long.
